correctness.rationale: Fourfold pedal theorem gives sigma=∏_sides dist(P,line)/∏_vertices |P-v|, strictly positive over open rectangle. For a>=b>0, one long-side denominator factor increases with y² and the other satisfies R_h(y)^2-(1-y²/b²)^2 R_h(0)^2=b^4 Ht[2H+6-(H+2)t]>0 for y≠0, yielding strict axial reduction. There f(s)=B(A-s)/[s²+2(B-A)s+(A+B)²], s=x², derivative sign (s-A)²-B(4A+B). The optimum shifts from s=0 to s=A-sqrt[B(4A+B)] exactly when (a/b)^2>2+sqrt(5). At equality s=0 is unique. Explicit pedal feet and the symmetry of intermediate polygons ensure axial maximizing points are admissible, so the global upper bound is attained. Independently reproduced the polynomial y-elimination and f derivative identities by exact symbolic algebra; source finite checker inspected, not assumed sufficient as infinite proof.
